\documentclass{article}
\usepackage{dirtreex}
\pagestyle{empty}
\makeatletter
\newcount\TModels \newcount\TEntries \newcount\TQueries
\newcount\TIndex
\newif\ifTOwnerLists
\ifdefined\dte@foreach@owner\TOwnerListstrue\else\TOwnerListsfalse\fi
\def\TFail#1{\PackageError{topology-lookup-contracts}{#1}{Independent parent/sibling oracle failed.}}
\def\TFlush{%
 \dte@flush@state
 \TIndex=1
 \loop\ifnum\TIndex<\numexpr\dte@cnt+1\relax
   \expandafter\ifx\csname dte@e\the\TIndex a\endcsname\relax
   \else\TFail{Active owners survived flush}\fi
   \expandafter\ifx\csname dte@e\the\TIndex l\endcsname\relax
   \else\TFail{Last-child flag survived flush}\fi
   \advance\TIndex by1
 \repeat}
\def\TStart#1{%
 \TFlush\global\dte@cnt=0
 \@for\TDepth:=#1\do{%
  \global\advance\dte@cnt by1
  \expandafter\xdef\csname dte@e\the\dte@cnt d\endcsname{\TDepth}}%
 \dte@i=701 \dte@j=702 \dte@k=703 \dte@scanidx=704
 \ifTOwnerLists
   \def\TPreprocessSentinel{outside-preprocess}%
   \let\dte@owners\TPreprocessSentinel
   \let\dte@rootlast\TPreprocessSentinel
 \fi
 % a/l must cross the producer's group; its scratch must not.
 \begingroup\dte@preprocess\endgroup
 \ifnum\dte@i=701\else\TFail{Preprocess index escaped its group}\fi
 \ifnum\dte@j=702\else\TFail{Preprocess depth escaped its group}\fi
 \ifnum\dte@k=703\else\TFail{Preprocess next-depth escaped its group}\fi
 \ifnum\dte@scanidx=704\else\TFail{Preprocess scan escaped its group}\fi
 \ifTOwnerLists
   \ifx\dte@owners\TPreprocessSentinel\else\TFail{Owner scratch escaped its group}\fi
   \ifx\dte@rootlast\TPreprocessSentinel\else\TFail{Root scratch escaped its group}\fi
 \fi
 \global\advance\TModels by1}
\def\TProject#1{%
 \edef\TReadList{#1}%
 \ifTOwnerLists
   \let\TActual\@empty
   \@for\TItem:=\TReadList\do{%
     \edef\TItemDepth{\dte@eget{\TItem}{d}}%
     \ifx\TActual\@empty
       \let\TActual\TItemDepth
     \else
       \edef\TActual{\TActual,\TItemDepth}%
     \fi}%
 \else
   \let\TActual\TReadList
 \fi}
\def\TEntry#1#2#3{%
 \ifnum\dte@eget{#1}{l}=#2\relax\else\TFail{Wrong last-child flag}\fi
 \TProject{\dte@eget{#1}{a}}\def\TExpected{#3}%
 \ifx\TActual\TExpected\else\TFail{Wrong ordered active-depth set}\fi
 \global\advance\TEntries by1}
% Read actual production data. Only the legacy representation needs its
% production Q helper to recover the owner of a stored depth.
\def\TReadOwner#1#2#3{%
 \edef\TReadList{#2}\def\TFound{0}%
 \@for\TItem:=\TReadList\do{%
   \ifTOwnerLists
     \ifnum\TItem>#1\relax\else\TFail{Stored owner is not a future entry}\fi
     \ifnum\TItem>\dte@cnt\TFail{Stored owner is outside this tree}\fi
     \edef\TItemDepth{\dte@eget{\TItem}{d}}%
   \else
     \let\TItemDepth\TItem
   \fi
   \ifnum\TItemDepth=#3\relax
     \ifnum\TFound=0\else\TFail{Repeated stored owner depth}\fi
     \ifTOwnerLists
       \let\TFound\TItem
     \else
       \dte@find@nextsibling{#1}{#3}\let\TFound\dte@nextidx
     \fi
   \fi}}
\def\TBoundaryDomain#1{%
 \TProject{\dte@safeget{dte@breaklines@1}}%
 \def\TPreviousDepth{-1}%
 \@for\TItemDepth:=\TActual\do{%
   \ifnum\TItemDepth>\TPreviousDepth\relax
   \else\TFail{Boundary depths are not unique and ordered}\fi
   \ifnum\TItemDepth>\numexpr\dte@eget{#1}{d}+1\relax
     \TFail{Boundary column exceeds active/feed depth domain}%
   \fi
   \let\TPreviousDepth\TItemDepth}}
\def\TQuery#1#2#3{%
 \ifTOwnerLists\else
   % The original helper's grouped/global result remains a control-only check.
   \begingroup\dte@find@nextsibling{#1}{#2}\endgroup
   \ifnum\dte@nextidx=#3\relax\else\TFail{Wrong style owner or nonglobal query result}\fi
 \fi
 \def\TBoundarySentinel{outside-boundary}%
 \expandafter\let\csname dte@breaklines@1\endcsname\TBoundarySentinel
 \expandafter\let\csname dte@breakidx@1\endcsname\TBoundarySentinel
 \begingroup
   % Each original oracle row now also checks actual active/boundary storage.
   % Q at depth zero below a nonroot row has no consumer: require absence.
   \def\TExpectedActive{0}%
   \ifnum#2>0
     \ifnum#2>\dte@eget{#1}{d}\relax\else
       \def\TExpectedActive{#3}%
     \fi
   \fi
   \let\TExpectedBoundary\TExpectedActive
   \ifnum\dte@eget{#1}{d}=0
     \ifnum#2=0 \def\TExpectedBoundary{#3}\fi
   \fi
   \ifnum#2>\dte@eget{#1}{d}\relax
     \ifnum#3=\numexpr#1+1\relax
       \def\TExpectedBoundary{#3}%
     \fi
   \fi
   \TReadOwner{#1}{\dte@safeget{dte@e#1a}}{#2}%
   \ifnum\TFound=\TExpectedActive\relax\else\TFail{Wrong stored active owner or absence}\fi
   \dte@store@breaklines{#1}{1}%
   \ifnum\dte@safeget{dte@breakidx@1}=#1\relax\else\TFail{Wrong stored boundary cut index}\fi
   \TBoundaryDomain{#1}%
   \TReadOwner{#1}{\dte@safeget{dte@breaklines@1}}{#2}%
   \ifnum\TFound=\TExpectedBoundary\relax\else\TFail{Wrong stored boundary owner or absence}\fi
 \endgroup
 \expandafter\ifx\csname dte@breaklines@1\endcsname\TBoundarySentinel
 \else\TFail{Boundary owner list escaped its group}\fi
 \expandafter\ifx\csname dte@breakidx@1\endcsname\TBoundarySentinel
 \else\TFail{Boundary cut index escaped its group}\fi
 % queries counts checked frozen oracle rows, not calls to a removed helper.
 \global\advance\TQueries by1}
